bullets.text: Nvidia's AI Acquisitions Surge — Nvidia is reportedly acquiring Hugging Face for $13 billion, reflecting a trend where major companies are investing heavily in open-weight AI models to diversify their offerings.
Meta Enhances Privacy Measures — A new update for Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses prevents users from disabling the privacy LED, addressing concerns over unauthorized recording.
AI User Privacy Concerns — A DuckDuckGo survey reveals that many users share sensitive information with AI chatbots, often unaware of how their data is used, raising privacy issues.
Smartphone Prices Set to Rise — Analysts predict that smartphone prices will remain high permanently, with a significant drop in shipments leading to fewer affordable options for consumers.
Meta's Ongoing Privacy Challenges — Meta continues to address privacy issues with its smart glasses, as it faces scrutiny over how it manages user data and recording capabilities.
